overview: The committee discussed a proposed ordinance governing the protection of public trees, focusing on enforcement protocols and the calculation of fines for unauthorized removals. Members also reviewed the structure and management of a dedicated tree fund for city replanting efforts.

items.title: Public Tree Ordinance Enforcement and Penalties
items.summary: The committee reviewed enforcement mechanisms for unauthorized public tree removal and debated how to calculate fines based on lost canopy coverage versus actual replanting capacity.

items.title: Tree Fund Management
items.summary: Members discussed the purpose and oversight of a proposed tree fund, which would be managed by the DPW and Tree Warden using revenue from fines to support city replanting and maintenance.

subject: Public Tree Ordinance Enforcement and Funding
